text: Two sources, one bronze layer: nightly POS exports land as-is, online orders flow through a Fabric Eventstream — both raw, untransformed, exactly as received.
Online orders arrive continuously, so a Fabric Eventstream is the right tool — an Event Hub feeds it, minimal transformation parses the payload, and rows land in a bronze Delta table.
Nightly POS exports are a known, bounded batch each night. Databricks Autoloader picks up only the new files incrementally, rather than re-scanning everything on every run.
An Eventstream retry could redeliver an event, so this design targets at-least-once delivery with idempotent landing — a MERGE keyed on the source event ID.
Same-day is now a real number: online sales visible in minutes, in-store sales by the next morning. Next up: transforming this bronze data into a proper star schema.
